description: Defines SQLAlchemy and Pydantic models for user and item management, including user registration, updates, authentication tokens, and database table mappings.

classes.name: UserBase
classes.description: Base model for user properties, including email, active status, superuser status, and full name.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a new user, extends UserBase with password field.

classes.name: UserRegister
classes.description: Model for user registration API input, includes email, password, and optional full name.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating user info, all fields optional.

classes.name: UserUpdateMe
classes.description: Model for updating current user's profile info.

classes.name: UpdatePassword
classes.description: Model for password change request, includes current and new password.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user, with UUID primary key, hashed password, creation timestamp, and relationship to items.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Public view of user data, including id and creation timestamp.

classes.name: UsersPublic
classes.description: Container for list of public users and total count.

classes.name: ItemBase
classes.description: Base model for item properties, including title and description.

classes.name: ItemUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating an item, with optional title.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Database model for an item, with UUID primary key, timestamp, owner relationship, and foreign key.

classes.name: ItemPublic
classes.description: Public view of item data, including id, owner_id, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: ItemsPublic
classes.description: Container for list of public items and total count.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Simple message model for API responses.

classes.name: TokenPayload
classes.description: JWT token contents, with optional subject.

classes.name: NewPassword
classes.description: Model for password reset, including token and new password.
